evidence_law: UNKNOWN != PASS. BLOCKED != PASS. IMPLEMENTED != VERIFIED. VERIFIED != PRODUCTION-PROVEN. A rung claim without the evidence its tier requires is a false claim and fails validation.

not_claimed: No node is claimed above CONTRACT on this pin: runtime, behavioral, production, and successor claims all require receipts that do not yet exist on main (see items dispatch, migrations-apply, know-hit-proof in the build list).
The other seat's naya_kernel runtime lane holds its own per-revision qualification; this tracker does not re-score that lane and never merges with it.
This file becoming CANONICAL requires human-director ratification (issue #864); validator rejects any other status.
purpose: Make per-node proof-ladder rung state visible and machine-checkable (not tribal). This file is the repository-side rung tracker feeding the #864 GitHub Project's Evidence State field. It records ONLY rungs justified by named evidence on the pinned commit. Missing evidence -> the rung stays where the evidence stops, never where the ambition goes.

rung_evidence_tiers.BEHAVIORAL: exact-revision runtime proof: named workflow run id on the exact pinned commit SHA demonstrating the node's governed behavior; INTEGRATION evidence retained
rung_evidence_tiers.CONTRACT: organism contract binds the node role + per-node contract accepted; STRUCTURAL evidence retained
rung_evidence_tiers.INTEGRATION: named multi-node handoff/chain tests pass on the exact pinned SHA with receipt; UNIT evidence retained
rung_evidence_tiers.OUTCOME: observed outcome receipts in nayanet_execution_receipts (or named canonical receipt table) attributable to this node; BEHAVIORAL evidence retained
rung_evidence_tiers.PRODUCTION: governed production promotion dispatch receipt on the exact SHA (human dispatch) + post-deploy migration-application verification; OUTCOME evidence retained
rung_evidence_tiers.STRUCTURAL: node identity + dedicated home directory + at least one contract artifact present in the pinned tree
rung_evidence_tiers.SUCCESSOR: cold successor handoff verification receipt: a fresh seat restores and acts from this node's persisted state without replayed context; PRODUCTION evidence retained
rung_evidence_tiers.UNIT: named unit tests under tests/ pass on the EXACT pinned SHA with no exclusions (or a named pytest battery on the exact bytes), receipts named

update_policy: Bump as_of to the exact SHA being rated; re-rate every node against the rung_evidence_tiers; run tools/validate_nine_node_activation_ladder.py; a promotion without new named evidence is rejected.
